{{Quote|Soldiers, we have by the dozens and are still outnumbered. But our foes have no legends; that's where we dwarf them.|Gobi Glie|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Ballad of Cham Syndulla">''[[The Clone Wars: The Ballad of Cham Syndulla]]''</ref>}}
'''Gobi Glie''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] minstrel on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Cham is still angry; he feels betrayed.|Gobi Glie|<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref>}}
[[File:Gobi2.png|thumb|left|150px|Gobi with a musical instrument]]
During the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he was contacted by [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and joined the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] in battling the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].

During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|battle]], Gobi served as Cham's deputy and led the freedom fighters to aid the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Ima-Gun Di]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keeli/Legends|Keeli]]. However, even the combined forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the freedom fighters were inferior to the battle droids, so Cham ordered Gobi and the freedom fighters to retreat. Even if the Jedi and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were trying hard to defend the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Gobi was less averse to standing, but he obeyed Cham's command. General Di and the remaining clones were going to a battle against the [[Droid Army|droid army]] one last time, allowing Gobi and other Twi'leks to escape over the mountains. Shortly thereafter, the freedom fighters received a replenishment delivery from the Republic blockade runners, which enabled their long struggle.<ref name="Supply Lines" />

However, they were initially forced to find a new hiding place after the Separatists took control of the capital city under the command of [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]]. While remaining in a hidden base, Gobi used his musical talents to create a ballad for Cham. Although Cham claimed that honor was unjustified, Gobi told him that he was a hero to the people of Ryloth.<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" /> Eventually, Gobi continued to battle the Separatists until badly wounded by a droid shot. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and his platoon arrived to aid the freedom fighters, Gobi joined the battle in retaking [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] and the capture of Wat Tambor. After the Separatists fled the planet, the people of Ryloth were free and the battle was over.<ref name="LoR">{{TCW|Libery on Ryloth}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gobi Glie is voiced by [[Corey Burton]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
